sources.title: GitHub - rldotai/ocr-experiments: Experimenting with some neural OCR ...
sources.snippet: OCR Experiments My experiments with some neural Optical Character Recognition OCR models. At the moment, I'm really just referencing other people's code, although eventually I'll have some more details on my own extensions.

sources.title: OCR Arena
sources.snippet: OCR Arena is a free playground for testing and evaluating leading foundation VLMs and open source OCR models side-by-side. Upload a document, measure accuracy, and vote for the best models on a public leaderboard.

sources.snippet: The model weights are available on Hugging Face: dots.mocr and dots.mocr-svg. 2025.10.31 🚀 We release dots.ocr.base, foundation VLM focus on OCR tasks, also the base model of dots.ocr. Try it out! 2025.07.30 🚀 We release dots.ocr, — a multilingual documents parsing model based on 1.7b llm, with SOTA performance.
